summary: Schema-only Track B implementation phase. Implements exactly one new Repository Intelligence artifact-family JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 file: schemas/repository_intelligence/artifacts/dependency_knowledge_graph_snapshot.schema.json. It represents graph-shaped knowledge structurally without constructing, traversing, or querying a graph.
